text: The impact of AI on jobs is still pretty unclear at this point. I don't find this very surprising, as employers are still figuring out individual adoption, let alone how you use AI in complex organizations. Things may start to happen faster as agents capable of real work spread.

I only used Dots briefly before launch, so can’t offer a detailed review, but I found it to be good & very much in the rapidly-expanding Clawlike category with Muse & Grokbot. Using a capable model with access to your data as an assistant & second opinion is remarkably useful.

It also has a natural analog on teams as a persistent entity with a job that you can delegate to using existing team communication tools like Slack. I expect more Clawlikes soon, though I don’t think they are the final form of this type of AI.

Anthropic published a guide this week on fixing prompts without fooling yourself.

it's written for developers running evals on codebases, but the loop underneath works on any prompt you're tuning by hand.

the problem: your prompt gets better on the examples you tested it on and worse everywhere else.

the fix is to get 20 real inputs. fix your prompt against 10 of them until the outputs are good. then, without changing anything, run the 10 you set aside. They will tell you whether you fixed the prompt or just those 10 examples.

i turned the whole loop into a system prompt you can run on anything you've been tweaking by feel. no code needed.

save this one.

At DevDay, OpenAI announced:

- Their answer to Muse and Grokbot: Dots (although not free like Muse)
- Their answer to Anthropic’s latest models: GPT-6.1-Sol
- Their answer to Jev: The decision API

They also announced ChatGPT Spaces and Ultrafast mode (at 6x cost) as well as everything being available in the cloud and an agents API (with computer use).

I saw Tibo at a grocery store in San Francisco yesterday. I told him how cool it was to meet him in person, but I didn’t want to be a douche and bother him and ask him for resets or anything.

He said, “Oh, like you’re doing now?”

I was taken aback, and all I could say was “Huh?” but he kept cutting me off and going “huh? huh? huh?” and closing his hand shut in front of my face. I walked away and continued with my shopping, and I heard him chuckle as I walked off. When I came to pay for my stuff up front I saw him trying to walk out the doors with like fifteen Milky Ways in his hands without paying.

The girl at the counter was very nice about it and professional, and was like “Sir, you need to pay for those first.” At first he kept pretending to be tired and not hear her, but eventually turned back around and brought them to the counter.

When she took one of the bars and started scanning it multiple times, he stopped her and told her to scan them each individually “to prevent any cache infetterence,” and then turned around and winked at me. I don’t even think that’s a word. After she scanned each bar and put them in a bag and started to say the price, he kept interrupting her by yawning really loudly.
@theo And then I ran to Theo and whispered in his right ear “wake up Theo, it’s DevDay today”

@jukan05 Hello, this is Tibo, you’ve reached the wrong company. Let me redirect you to …

Announcing dots. Dots work 24/7 for you, learn from your feedback, have their own computer, browser and can be connected to over 4k apps in our ecosystem.

They’re powered by Astra our best model yet. Included in your Pro plan, without drawing down on any of your usage. You can even call a dot while it’s working.

We’re getting you started with your primary dot today and soon you’ll be able to create entire teams of them.

Announcing ChatGPT Space, a collection of new collaborative experiences right in ChatGPT. 

Edit rich notes with live visualizations together with others and your dots. Whether it’s a TODO list to delegate, a product plan or meeting notes. Working with others and your agents is seamless and they also be automatically kept up to date in the background. For developers, this is AGENTS.md taken one step further.

Introducing 6.1 Sol, near Astra intelligence at one fifth of the price of Astra and 95% cache read discount. It is an absolute workhorse.

Combined with ultrafast for 8X speeded available today for Astra and coming soon for 6.1 Sol.
Decisions API, for lightning fast constrained decision making powered by Luna. Supports visual inputs, and tuned to be able to make decisions in less than a few hundreds of milliseconds end to end.

Launching a new Codex Cloud, much improved from last year. With configurable cloud environments, it’s impossible to go back to building on your laptop once you’ve taken the time to configure it.

Agents API, the same tech powering all our cloud agents, including dots, is also now in preview and supports computer use. It allows you to build the same incredible products we are making available today.
Token traffic on responses API has increased 100X compared to today last year. Meanwhile the team improved reliability with 99.9% uptime and improving performance significantly.
Dots are included in all Pro, Business Premium and Enterprise plans. This includes the Pro 100 plan. We’ll be looking to further expand access soon.

We are opening up our platform and you can now build full native apps with plugin extensions, and ship them right in ChatGPT. We have over 1.2B weekly users and will surface relevant plugins right in the conversations.

Almost all the things we announced will be available today. Can’t see what you will do with it.

Sign in with ChatGPT and go.
